arguments.code: async ({ shell: { exec } }) => { const r = await exec(`npm run check 2>&1 | grep -v "^  .*|" | tail -25`, { timeoutMs: 290000 }); const c = await exec(`npm run check >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?`, { timeoutMs: 290000 }); return r.stdout + "\nexit " + c.stdout; }
arguments.label: Run check and report exit code and tail
